messages:
maria: quick summary from yesterday's GPU/region run — LLaMA-2-7B and Mistral-7B on A100(40GB) vs H100(80GB) in us-west1 and eu-west1. dumping the highlights and a tiny command snippet.
kevin: awesome — TL;DR numbers up top? can we get prefill + per-token decode and $/1M tokens?
sophia: also curious if quantized runs (q4_k_m) changed perf/quality tradeoffs.
maria: sure. raw experiment config: 1 thread per GPU, batch size=1 (low-latency), seq=512 prefills + greedy decode. kernels: cuBLAS baseline, Triton fused decoder for H100, custom fused for A100. quant: fp16 vs q4_k_m. command used:```bash
./run_infer --model llm-7b --gpu-type H100 --region us-west1 --prefill 512 --decode greedy
```
infra-bot: experiment artifacts uploaded: https://internal-bench/reports/2141599999 (graphs + raw logs) :file_folder:
evalbot: computed summary (numbers median across 50 runs each):

```
Model            GPU   Region    prefill_ms(512)  ms_per_token  tokens/sec  $/1M_tokens
LLaMA-2-7B       A100  us-west1  140              0.40          2500        $0.28
LLaMA-2-7B       H100  us-west1  100              0.28          3571        $0.32
LLaMA-2-7B       A100  eu-west1  155              0.42          2381        $0.30
LLaMA-2-7B       H100  eu-west1  110              0.30          3333        $0.34
Mistral-7B       A100  us-west1  160              0.48          2083        $0.43
Mistral-7B       H100  us-west1  110              0.27          3703        $0.30
Mistral-7B       A100  eu-west1  175              0.50          2000        $0.45
Mistral-7B       H100  eu-west1  120              0.29          3448        $0.33
```

Notes on cost calc: assumed GPU $/hr A100=$2.5, H100=$4.0; $/1M_tokens = (gpu_hr_cost * 1e6) / (tokens/sec * 3600).
maria: quick interpretation: H100 gives clear throughput advantage for Mistral (tokens/sec jump ~1.7x) which makes H100 cheaper per token there. For LLaMA-2-7B the H100 throughput gain (~1.43x) doesn't fully offset the higher hourly price so A100 ends up slightly cheaper per 1M tokens for that model.
kevin: interesting — region deltas look small but eu-west1 has slightly higher prefill tail. any idea why?
sophia: looked into infra: eu-west1 has slightly older PCIe topology on our current SKU and a different kernel build (missing a Triton micro-optim). that explains ~10-15% prefill penalty. filing infra ticket.
maria: quantization note: q4_k_m yields ~20% lower mem and ~15% throughput bump on A100, ~10% on H100, but evalbot flagged a 1.8% drop in Rouge-L on our synthetic prompt set for Mistral. tradeoff.
evalbot: quality delta details: Mistral q4_k_m avg Rouge-L -1.8%, LLaMA-2-7B q4_k_m avg -0.6%. see artifacts for per-prompt breakdown.
kevin: recommendations?
maria: short: for latency-sensitive LLaMA workloads (small responses) default to A100+fp16 unless we roll out the fused Triton decoder + q4_k_m which narrows cost gap. for high-throughput Mistral production, prefer H100 in us-west1; in eu-west1 wait for infra kernel patch. Also add region-aware routing policy: prefer cheaper GPU/region combo by model. :gear: :rocket:
sophia: I'll open a PR to add a routing policy flag and an infra task for eu-west1 kernel.
kevin: perfect. can we schedule a 30min sync tomorrow to decide the rollout path?
maria: yes — 10:30am PT works for me. tagging @kevin @sophia.
